agent_tasks_lease_complete.name: agent_tasks_lease_complete
agent_tasks_lease_complete.value: "agent_tasks"."status" <> 'leased' or ("agent_tasks"."agent_id" is not null and "agent_tasks"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

batch_products_notes_length.name: batch_products_notes_length
batch_products_notes_length.value: "batch_products"."notes" is null or char_length("batch_products"."notes") between 1 and 4000

batch_products_not_empty.name: batch_products_not_empty
batch_products_not_empty.value: "batch_products"."notes" is not null or "batch_products"."edit_reference_url" is not null

products_emoji_length.name: products_emoji_length
products_emoji_length.value: "products"."emoji" is null or char_length("products"."emoji") between 1 and 16

videos_edit_texts_length.name: videos_edit_texts_length
videos_edit_texts_length.value: ("videos"."edit_main_text" is null or char_length("videos"."edit_main_text") <= 200) and ("videos"."edit_cta_text" is null or char_length("videos"."edit_cta_text") <= 200)
